relevance_note: Single-patient case report of LAD-I with ITGB2 variants: 'a missense mutation (ITGB2: c.817G>A; pGly273Arg) on the paternal allele'.
method_note: Read by hand; a short script only assembled the JSON. One patient, a boy, labelled 'patient' (rule 5; 'our patient' is a role word). The parents ('unrelated healthy Danish parents') get no rows: they are not described as tested or affected. The Markdown prints '>' as '>'; spans keep '>' verbatim, values use '>'. Protein string kept as printed without the dot ('pGly273Arg'). Inheritance taken from 'on the paternal allele' and 'encompassing the maternal ITGB2 gene'; the paper gives no explicit parental testing statement, so parental_testing_statement is 'not reported'. Zygosity left 'not reported' (the paper never says compound heterozygous). 'novel' for the deletion not taken as a pathogenicity classification. Functional statement for c.817G>A ('known to prevent CD11a/CD18 hetero-dimerization') is cited from reference 2, not measured here. 'His infectious history until then was characterized solely by recurrent bacterial skin infections' was NOT used to exclude other infection checklist items (sepsis, otitis, etc.), as those are never named. Age at diagnosis not recorded: referral at 11 months is stated, but no age is given for the diagnosis itself. Age at last evaluation = 24 months (bone marrow transplantation); vital status after that not stated. Table 1 (unnumbered in the Markdown, columns reference range / LAD-1 / Control) has OCR damage; only the neutrophil row was used. The pTFH row is a pre/7/21-day time series for one person, not used for features. No contradictions found.
